title: Bacterial Cryopreservation
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ihncb5e

steps.title: Transfer dense culture
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 20 mL of a dense bacterial culture into a sterile centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge culture
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 4,500 rpm for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant into bacterial waste.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL of the appropriate growth medium.

steps.title: Aliquot into cryovials
steps.instruction: Split the 2 mL suspension into two cryogenic vials, adding 1 mL to each vial.

steps.title: Recover frozen cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and recover cells from a cryogenic vial.

substeps.instruction: Remove one cryogenic vial from the freezer.
Using a sterile pipette tip, scrape a small amount of frozen cells from the vial.
Transfer the scraped cells into 20 mL of sterile growth medium and move the suspension to appropriate growth conditions.
Immediately place the empty cryogenic vial back into the freezer.
